routines.notes: Canonical exercise names and order. Deano may refer to exercises conversationally or with shortened names; match those references to these saved movements. Log actual weight and reps for every set on every workout day. Warm-up sets are recorded separately from the two working sets.

workout_entries.notes: 3 run intervals: 7.0 mph × 2 min each; 3 incline intervals: 3.4 mph at 15% × 4 min each; 2 min warm-up walk, cooldown, and walking between intervals. Heart-rate pattern: runs typically >150 bpm; incline builds to ~120–130 bpm. Watch active energy is recorded separately as the day's total.

Superset 1: warmup 10×45 lb shoulder press + 10×25 lb curl; set 2 8×55 lb press + 8×35 lb curl; set 3 8×55 lb press + 8×55 lb curl. Superset 2: 2 sets of 8×20 lb lateral raise + 8×35 lb twisting curl. Superset 3: 2 sets of 8×20 lb reverse fly + 8×25 lb hammer curl. Leg extension and leg curl: 1×10 each at 130 lb. Core: lower-back forward extension 2×10 at 45 lb; side bends 2×10 each side at 25 lb; decline situps 2×15 slow, bodyweight. Stair finish as shown in reference image.
Lower-back forward extensions: 2 sets × 10 reps with 45 lb plate; side bends: 2 sets × 10 reps each side with 25 lb; decline bench sit-ups: 2 sets × 15 slow reps, bodyweight.
Stair-machine finisher performed after the shoulders + biceps, legs, and core work. Exact interval settings are not present in the canonical data.

Superset 1 — Flat dumbbell bench press + seated concentration curls (elbow braced against inner thigh). Warm-up set: flat press 60 lb dumbbells × 10 reps; concentration curls 30 lb dumbbells × 10 reps. Set 2: flat press 65 lb dumbbells × 12 reps; concentration curls 30 lb dumbbells × 10 reps. Set 3: flat press 65 lb dumbbells × 10 reps; concentration curls 30 lb dumbbells × 8 reps. Superset 2 — Incline dumbbell bench press + standing twisting curls. Set 1: incline press 60 lb dumbbells × 10 reps; standing twisting curls 30 lb dumbbells × 8 reps. Set 2: incline press 60 lb dumbbells × 10 reps; standing twisting curls 30 lb dumbbells × 10 reps. Superset 3 — flat-bench dumbbell flys (butterflies) + triceps pulldowns. Set 1 butterfly: 40 lb dumbbells × 10 reps. Set 1 triceps pulldown: machine setting 115 lb × 15 reps. Set 2 butterfly: 40 lb dumbbells × 8 reps. Set 2 triceps pulldown: machine setting 115 lb × 12 reps. Superset complete. Core/lower-back work — Set 1: straight lower-back extensions holding 45 lb × 12 reps; weighted side bends holding 25 lb × 10 reps each side. Set 2: straight lower-back extensions holding 45 lb × 15 reps; weighted side bends holding 25 lb × 10 reps each side. Lower-back/side-bend work complete. Dumbbell triceps extensions, performed one arm at a time. Set 1: 25 lb × 10 reps each arm. Set 2: 25 lb × 12 reps each arm.

HIIT cardio: 25 minutes, usual interval pattern. Warm-up: lat pulldown machine 130 lb × 10 reps; assisted/resting-feet dips × 15 reps. During dips, shoulder felt tight; possible upper-trap compensation/form issue, under assessment. Set 2: lat pulldown machine 175 lb × 8 reps (too heavy); bodyweight dips × 10 reps. Dip form adjusted to chest upright; shoulder involvement decreased, with more sensation along the outer/lateral pecs and some triceps engagement. Final pulldown/dip round: lat pulldown machine 160 lb × 10 reps; bodyweight dips × 10 reps. Superset — Set 1: seated machine row 175 lb × 10 reps; machine triceps extension 115 lb × 12 reps. Superset — Set 2: seated machine row 175 lb × 10 reps; machine triceps extension 130 lb × 10 reps. Final superset — Set 1: one-arm dumbbell bench row 60 lb × 10 reps each arm; single-arm dumbbell triceps extension 25 lb × 10 reps each arm. Final superset — Set 2: one-arm dumbbell bench row 60 lb × 12 reps each arm; single-arm dumbbell triceps extension 25 lb × 10 reps each arm. Core/lower-back finisher — Superset 1: 45-degree Roman-chair straight back extensions holding 45 lb × 12 reps; weighted side extensions holding 25 lb × 10 reps each side. Core/lower-back finisher — Superset 2: 45-degree Roman-chair straight back extensions holding 45 lb × 15 reps; weighted side extensions holding 25 lb × 10 reps each side. Core/lower-back finisher complete.
